AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Tassel Designer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Tassels play an important and indispensable role in the culture of Oberonia Aurea. Whether conveying blessings or simply decorating, tassels are often used to some extent.\n\nThese tassels also attracted [PAWN_nameDef], leading [PAWN_pronoun] to devote [PAWN_pronoun] wholeheartedly to tassel design. Today, [PAWN_nameDef] is once again surrounded by colorful tassels, spending another day in their company.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Celebrant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Goodwill is an instinct that needs no reason, and [PAWN_nameDef] believes the same is true for celebration.\n\nNo food is better than what is served at a gathering, and no atmosphere surpasses the joy of a celebration. [PAWN_nameDef] moves from one festival to another, with blessings and goodwill making up every moment of [PAWN_pronoun] life. It is foreseeable that [PAWN_nameDef] will head to the next celebration tomorrow, eagerly offering blessings to everyone.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Festival Coordinator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: In the administrative structure of Oberonia Aurea, festivals are usually organized by the Court Department. The division [PAWN_nameDef] works in is the specific body responsible for festival celebrations.\n\nWhenever a festival approaches, [PAWN_nameDef] often has to prepare and plan well in advance, engaging in considerable bargaining with the Coordination Department. Compared to other members of the Court Department, this job is undeniably troublesome. Yet whenever festival day arrives, with decorations lining the streets and joyful crowds gathering at the venue, [PAWN_nameDef] always feels it is all worth it.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Ritual Officer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: In a conservative, traditional, and gentle society, festivals are a vital and indispensable part of life. As a senior court official, [PAWN_nameDef] is fully responsible for organizing most major local celebrations.\n\nAlthough in a sense this position carries significant authority, it is clear that [PAWN_nameDef] cares more about the heartfelt blessings and sincere wishes on the festival day, and about the mutual coordination and help during preparation, than about the rigid, impersonal nature of power itself.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Ritual Officer of the Navigation Departmen
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: The Navigation Department is renowned in the Oberonia Aurea court for its emphasis on tradition and the spirit of exploration. It is evident that the departure ceremony is the best embodiment of this traditional spirit.\n\nBefore every starship departs from the spaceport, the Navigation Department sends attendants to assist the crew in conducting the traditional departure ceremony. The arrangement and assignment of these ceremonies ultimately need to be organized by [PAWN_nameDef].

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Superstitious Crew Member
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Although citizens of Oberonia Aurea remain atheist in the vast majority of cases, every rule has an exception, and that exception is clearly [PAWN_nameDef], whose bedroom is filled with constellations and totems.\n\nNo one has ever been able to understand what those totems and constellation patterns [PAWN_nameDef] believes in actually mean, but everyone knows [PAWN_pronoun] firmly believes in them. Perhaps one day [PAWN_nameDef] will find these beliefs useless, but until then, [PAWN_pronoun] will continue to find absolute peace of mind in these patterns.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Mountain Rescuer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Perhaps because of the tradition of long-distance travel, there is an endless stream of explorers who choose adventure and exploration on remote planets. Although most people have ample ability to face difficulties, emergencies still occur from time to time, among which distress calls from mountainous environments account for the highest proportion.\n\nIn the complex mountain terrains of remote planets, tactile robots often cannot be deployed in time, and most of the time real-time on-site rescue is needed from rescuers like [PAWN_nameDef]. This work is undoubtedly risky, but [PAWN_nameDef] believes those risks are far outweighed by the value of a life.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Notable Birthday Celebrant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is quite well-known in [PAWN_pronoun] neighborhood, and this fame stems from [PAWN_pronoun] birthday party.\n\nPerhaps the happiness of the birthday dulled [PAWN_pronoun] senses, or perhaps the flurry of blessings overloaded [PAWN_pronoun] mind. But regardless, when [PAWN_nameDef], unaware that the hood of [PAWN_pronoun] ceremonial robe had already been filled with Golden Iris flowers by child attendants, put it on without a second thought, the brilliant rain of petals—along with [PAWN_nameDef], overwhelmed by the shower of blessings—was destined to be etched into the memory of everyone present.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Flower Cake Artisan
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As a traditional gift of Oberonia Aurea, the improvement and innovation of flower cake craftsmanship is an eternal pursuit for all pastry chefs. This goal has been passed down for so long that in the hearts of some pastry chefs, it has become something akin to a faith.\n\nAs a pastry chef equally devoted to delicious cakes, [PAWN_nameDef] is clearly part of this great pursuit. This sense of mission drives [PAWN_pronoun] to try all kinds of cooking methods—until recently, when [PAWN_pronoun] came across a curious thing called "foot-trodden flower cake"...

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Head Chef of the Science Department
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: In the Oberonia Aurea court, the Science Department is often seen as a symbol of being scatterbrained and unreliable. This impression can be seen both in their research results and in their daily lives—especially in cooking.\n\nYet within the Science Department, where bizarre, colorful dark cuisine prevails, [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the very few who can truly be said to possess culinary skill. This ability means that most of the time, [PAWN_pronoun] is frequently loaned out between various research teams, single-handedly keeping the department fed on a daily basis.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Pyrotechnician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Although gun culture is not well-developed, Oberonia Aurea unexpectedly possesses excellent pyrotechnic craftsmanship. Whenever a festival arrives, [PAWN_nameDef] organizes fireworks displays at different locations according to the festival schedule, until the deep night sky is dyed with longed-for flames.\n\nIn over a decade of work, [PAWN_nameDef] has seen all kinds of fireworks. Though their features vary, [PAWN_nameDef] has always believed [PAWN_pronoun] could maintain order at the launch site—a confidence that lasted until the day [PAWN_pronoun] saw an antiparticle warhead listed in the fireworks catalog.
